北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴冷，体感 -6℃，注意保暖防干燥哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but chilly, feels like -6℃. Stay warm and hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴冷风大，体感 -4℃，记得多穿衣别着凉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and windy, feels like -4℃. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴冷，体感 -1℃，出门添衣，暖暖和和过一天。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and cold, feels like -1℃. Add layers when going out for a warm day.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云暖和，体感 21℃，早晚温差大，别大意哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and warm, feels like 21℃. Mind the temperature difference between morning and evening.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 20℃，空气湿润。穿着舒适，心情棒棒！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels like 20℃ with humid air. Dress comfortably and enjoy your day!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴冷，体感 -2℃，北风呼呼，注意防风保暖。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and cold, feels like -2℃ with a strong north wind. Keep warm and stay wind-protected.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴冷，体感 -3℃，风力不小，多加衣物别受凉。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and cold, feels like -3℃ with strong winds. Wear more layers to avoid getting cold.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 7℃，温度宜人。出门别忘了带伞哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 7℃. A pleasant temperature, but don't forget your umbrella!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴冷，体感 3℃，出门多穿点，暖心又暖身。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and cool, feels like 3℃. Wear more layers when going out to stay warm.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴好，体感 2℃，空气干燥。注意补水，保持滋润。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and cool, feels like 2℃ with very dry air. Remember to hydrate and moisturize.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 10℃，湿度 96%。注意防潮，保持好心情！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 10℃ with 96% humidity. Watch out for dampness and stay cheerful!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨严寒，体感 -23℃！全副武装，注意防冻伤。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, feels like -23℃! Bundle up completely and prevent frostbite.
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -23℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷，体感 -19℃，北风呼啸。保暖工作要做好！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and very cold, feels like -19℃ with a howling north wind. Make sure to stay well-protected!
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -19℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，体感 12℃。阳光正好，别忘了保湿防晒哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and pleasant, feels like 12℃. The sun is out, remember to moisturize and protect from UV!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感 10℃，风力 4级。外出记得添衣防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 10℃ with Force 4 winds. Remember to add layers and protect from wind when out.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 -9℃，北风 5级。风寒效应强，穿厚点！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels like -9℃ with Force 5 north winds. The wind chill is strong, dress warmly!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴冷，体感 -13℃。注意防寒保暖，别冻着啦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny and very cold, feels like -13℃. Take care to keep warm and avoid freezing.
